newsitem.title: USA: AMR Corp rejects opposition to British deal.
newsitem.headline: AMR Corp rejects opposition to British deal.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines rejected as hypocritical a rival airline's opposition to its proposed alliance with British Airways Plc.
The U.S. airline said United Airlines had no reason to oppose the proposal because it had a similar one with a German carrier.
"We find their opposition to our alliance the epitome of hypocrisy," it said in a statement. "United...has an alliance with Deutsche Lufthansa AG that enjoys antitrust immunity."
UAL Corp's United Airlines submitted its opposition to the United Kingdom's Office of Fair Trade, which is reviewing the proposal.
Many airlines and consumer groups have done the same, saying the alliance would dominate the London trans-Atlantic route.
The Office of Fair Trade said earlier on Tuesday that it had yet to advise the British trade minister on whether or not the proposal should be referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.

Under such an alliance, British Airways would coordinate its flights from Britain to the United States with all of American's flights from the United States to a number of European destinations. The two airlines would also combine their frequent flyer programs and share flight booking codes.
American said it would only go ahead with the alliance if the two countries liberalized the market with an "open skies" trade pact.
